driverOptions: the driver's defaults, the same for both sides (--dnf-s 120, --memory-at-s 20)
method: One generator run gives every side the same tasks, links and dates, and each side loads its own file of that data in its own shape (DHTMLX its own file; ours the ours.json that it hands to mount(el, { tasks, links }) on demos/bench/sides/ours-page.html). Memory is the browser total 20 s after the navigation, the page idle. The comparison is load and draw: DHTMLX community cannot schedule, and ours solves the schedule on open.
tree: The runs are the directories beside this file: <cell>/<pair>/<side>/{result.json,side.json,load.log,wait.log} and <cell>/dataset.json.sha256. dataset.json is not kept: node demos/bench/dataset.ts --shape <shape> --size <n> --seed 20261020 --out <dir> rebuilds it byte for byte, and its SHA-256 is in dataset.json.sha256. Print the table with: node demos/dhtmlx-compare/table.ts demos/bench/results

tree4-10000.note: pair 2 not matched: load1 means differ by 0.80 (limit 0.5), or a result refused or swap grew; kept and listed, not counted

box.quietCap: load1 under 4 before each side (--max-load 4, not raised)
box.wallClock: 2026-11-05 09:27 to 10:19 MST, up to 8 attempts per cell; at the start no Chrome for Testing process was running and no cargo, rustc or Playwright process was on the mini (pgrep), and two users were logged in; pairs that were not matched are kept and listed under cells
